name: spec-video
description: Turn a written spec or ADR into a Remotion product-walkthrough film. Complementary routing to video-editing, fal.ai, and FFmpeg.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a written spec into a Remotion product-walkthrough film.
interface.longDescription: Reads a spec or ADR, extracts a Monday-morning product path (room, ask, computers, artifact), scaffolds a nested Remotion project by hand, still-checks key frames, and renders 1920×1080. Routes to video-editing/FFmpeg for real footage and fal.ai only for missing assets. Does not generate architecture-diagram movies or whole-film AI video.
capabilities: Monday-morning path storyboard from a spec or ADR
Hand-scaffolded nested Remotion project (no create-video inside git)
Routing to FFmpeg and fal.ai for footage and holes only
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a spec-video of this spec. Load skills/spec-video/SKILL.md and follow it.
